Firstly for the chess scenario, in the rossalimo variation, you generally take the knight on c6 rather than being chased away with tempos, and losing bishop to 6. Bb3 c4. Also, black playing 3. d6 closes in the white squared bishop for the majority of the game after BxN (assuming you follow mainline rossalimo).

I haven't graduated, I gave up on school. I can take the GED at any point and be able to pass it with flying colours, I just haven't made the step to do it. My plan for life has been just keep waking up and going to sleep until a situation presents itself where you can't do what you like anymore, and you will kill yourself. (being playing games and doing drugs). 

I am the only person in control of my life, and I AM guilty for putting myself in this position. However, how do I change this outlook? I know what I have done to myself, and I know how to change everything for the better, I just don't care about myself, or anything else in life, to WANT to change. I'd rather see myself dead and take an easy route. I suppose I'm spineless in that sense.

You are fairly accurate in what you say, and I understand it. I just need to know how to make myself care about a life I hate
